findings.title: Intentional repair turns the promise into a return
findings.claim: The believers are defined by continuing work that restores soundness, so the promised reward can be heard as the beneficial return of intentional repair.
findings.mechanism: The carrier يَعْمَلُونَ names deliberate ongoing work, ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ names work in a sound and restorative condition, and أَجْرًا names a beneficial return. The supplied guidance-to-reward and repair-to-return connections make that action-to-return relation recur beyond the focus.
findings.reader_payoff: The promise becomes actionable: the reader can perceive a path from hearing the warning, through chosen repair, to a return that belongs to the work rather than to a passive label.
findings.containment: The relative clause still describes believers who do righteous deeds and the ayah still announces their reward. The global action grammar is a qualified contextual resonance; it does not make every work righteous, turn the reward into a wage contract, or replace the plain promise.

epistemic.reason: The trusted publication supplies exact focus anchors, while the legacy reader records add the recurrent action-grammar formulation. The wider work, repair, and reward links are supplied, but their integration into one action-to-return mechanism is an inference.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir yapanın bilerek ortaya koyduğu iş veya eylem anlamı çekirdektir.
branch_activations.carrier: The imperfect verb يَعْمَلُونَ carries continuing, intentional work by the believers named in the relative clause.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 17:9, 18:30, and 18:110 independently join guidance or believing response to righteous work and its promised return.
branch_activations.activation: The focus work carrier meets those repeated guidance-to-work-to-reward relations, so the believers' action becomes the continuing response through which the promise is carried forward.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The promised reward is attached to deliberate ongoing work rather than to an inactive identity alone.
branch_activations.boundary: The carrier remains the work verb in this relative clause; no claim is made that every work is righteous or rewarded.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Kişi, iş veya şey bozukluğun ve kötülüğün karşıtı olan iyi, düzgün ve yararlı bir durumda bulunur.
branch_activations.carrier: ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ carries deeds characterized by soundness and restored condition.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 25:71 joins repentance to righteous action, while 29:7 joins righteous work to the removal of wrongs and recompense by the best deeds.
branch_activations.activation: The soundness carrier meets these repair-and-return contexts, making the focus work perceptible as a response that repairs what has been disordered.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The deeds named in the promise carry a restorative direction: they answer warning by bringing a damaged condition toward soundness.
branch_activations.boundary: This retains the general soundness-and-repair branch; it does not activate the separate interpersonal reconciliation branch or specify one repair act.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: iş veya anlaşma karşılığında sağlanan yarar
branch_activations.facet_statement: Yapılan bir iş nedeniyle işi yapan kişiye yarar olarak dönen karşılıktır.
branch_activations.carrier: أَجْرًا carries a beneficial return assigned after work.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 18:30, 18:88, and 18:107 repeatedly connect faithful righteous work with a good or enduring return.
branch_activations.activation: The reward carrier meets those wider work-to-return instances, so the focus promise can be heard as a return related to the work it names.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The reward becomes the beneficial outcome that comes back through the sound work of the believers.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus selects a promised recompense; no worldly hiring, lease, or legal wage relation is imported.

findings.title: Good reward becomes tested good and beneficial return
findings.claim: The adjective حَسَنًا can make the promised reward perceptible both as genuinely good and as a beneficial result, so its goodness is tested in the work that receives it rather than reduced to attractive appearance.
findings.mechanism: The focus adjective carries positive beauty and approval, while the same focus carrier also admits the good-result branch. The supplied 18:31, 18:88, and 10:26 connections set enduring or increased return against merely earthly adornment and make goodness a consequential quality.
findings.reader_payoff: The reward's goodness gains a criterion: what appears pleasing is opened toward a return whose value is confirmed by the quality and outcome of the work.
findings.containment: أَجْرًا حَسَنًا remains a good reward in the plain promise. Tested goodness is a qualified contextual resonance, not a claim that the adjective means only moral verification or that every beauty reference is deceptive.

epistemic.reason: The trusted publication anchors the focus adjective, while the legacy walk adds the tested-good formulation. The supplied return connections support the contact, but the move from positive evaluation to tested moral value is interpretive.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: akla, eğilime veya duyulara göre güzel ve beğenilir olma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir kişi veya şeyin güzel ve beğenilir olması, çirkinliğin karşıtı olan temel anlamdır.
branch_activations.carrier: حَسَنًا carries the positive, desirable quality attached grammatically to the reward noun.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 18:31 contrasts tested earthly adornment with the enduring beauty of the righteous workers' return.
branch_activations.activation: The focus adjective meets that supplied contrast between appearance and enduring return, so its positive evaluation can be heard as a goodness that withstands testing.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The promised reward is good in a value-bearing sense that survives the contrast with merely attractive adornment.
branch_activations.boundary: The beauty/evaluation carrier remains attached to the reward adjective; no general claim about all uses of حَسَن is made.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: kişiye ulaşan sevindirici iyilik, karşılık veya iyi sonuç

branch_activations.carrier: The same حَسَنًا carrier can qualify the reward as a beneficial result that reaches its recipients.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 18:88 names the good return of faithful work, while 10:26 presents the best return as an increase beyond a merely matching recompense.
branch_activations.activation: Those outcome-focused connections meet the adjective on أَجْرًا and make its goodness materially consequential rather than merely descriptive.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The good reward is newly legible as an arriving beneficial outcome, not only as an attractive quality.
branch_activations.boundary: The result branch supplements the evaluative branch; it does not erase the ordinary adjective or specify the form of the reward beyond the supplied connections.

findings.title: The upright Book holds warning and promise in order
findings.claim: The focus-initial adjective can make the Book a standard that stays straight while actively holding its warning and good-news consequences in order.
findings.mechanism: قَيِّمًا carries both durable straightness and continuous guardianship/governance. Supplied upright-writing and confirming-Book parallels meet warning-and-outcome pairs, while the legacy records add the attributed 18:1 and 18:3-5 correction and guardianship pressure.
findings.reader_payoff: Warning and glad tidings become coordinated effects of one maintained standard: the Book is newly perceptible as a text whose order protects the consequences it announces.
findings.containment: The adjective remains the Book's upright quality across the 18:1-18:2 boundary. Governance and ordered consequences are qualified contextual resonances; they do not replace the ordinary reading, settle the antecedent beyond the supplied boundary, or turn the Book into an exhaustive moral system.

epistemic.reason: The trusted publication anchors both focus branches, while the two legacy records supply matching straight/regulative and retrospective guardianship formulations. Exact connection Arabic supports the wider contacts; the integrated protective function remains an inference.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şey fiziksel, davranışsal veya yargısal olarak düz çizgisini korur, dengeli olur ve sapmaz.
branch_activations.carrier: قَيِّمًا carries the Book's straight, balanced, non-deviating quality.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 98:3 supplies upright revealed writings, 46:12 joins a confirming Book to warning and good news, and 9:52 sets opposed outcomes within one announced frame; the legacy records attribute the same ordering pressure to 18:1 and 18:3-5.
branch_activations.activation: The focus adjective meets those wider written-guidance and opposed-outcome scenes, so straightness becomes an ordering standard through which the Book's paired consequences remain intelligible.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The Book's uprightness can be perceived as a stable norm that keeps warning and promise from becoming disconnected announcements.
branch_activations.boundary: The carrier remains the adjective qualifying the Book; no complete doctrine of all later outcomes is inferred.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Sorumlu kişi ya da güç, bir işi veya topluluğu sürekli gözetir, korur ve yönetir.
branch_activations.carrier: The same قَيِّمًا carrier can carry continuous guardianship and management of an order.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 3:2 supplies sustaining governance behind revelation and judgment, while 65:10 joins severe punishment to a descended reminder; the legacy records attribute durable guardianship to the supplied 18:3-5 context.
branch_activations.activation: The governance facet meets those sustaining-revelation and warning-consequence contacts, so the Book's straightness is also heard as an active care that keeps the announced order standing.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The Book appears as a continuously protective regulator of the warning and glad-tiding frame.
branch_activations.boundary: This is a contextual governance resonance, not a claim that the adjective is a divine title here or that the Book independently acts apart from its revealed guidance.

findings.title: Uprightness stays operative as maintained practice
findings.claim: The Book's قَيِّمًا quality can be heard as an uprightness kept in force through the requirements it sustains and has people carry out.
findings.mechanism: The focus adjective carries the collocational branch of maintaining what must be fulfilled. Supplied qiyam connections show prescribed worship and communal maintenance as continuing practices that return the sustaining relation to the focus Book.
findings.reader_payoff: The Book's straightness becomes something encountered in practice: an order that remains alive because its requirements continue to be carried out.
findings.containment: The adjective still describes the Book's upright quality. The maintained-practice image is a qualified contextual resonance; it does not turn قَيِّمًا into an imperative or import the full details of the connected worship scenes.

epistemic.reason: The focus branch and exact wider connection records are supplied, but connection records carry no explicit trust labels and the cross-domain integration is an inference.

branch_activations.facet_statement: İbadetin ve kutsal kitabın gereklerini uygulamak, genel yerine getirme işleminin özel bağlamıdır.
branch_activations.carrier: قَيِّمًا carries the possibility that a revealed order remains operative through the requirements it sustains.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 4:103 places timed worship under a prescribed Book, while 73:20 and 5:97 depict sustained standing and public order as continuing qiyam functions.
branch_activations.activation: The collocational maintenance facet meets those continuing practice and order scenes, returning the act of keeping requirements to the focus adjective on the Book.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Uprightness becomes an operative standard maintained through enacted requirements.
branch_activations.boundary: No particular ritual obligation is assigned to the focus adjective, and the branch is not used as a replacement for straightness or governance.

findings.title: The upright Book as sustaining mainstay
findings.claim: The focus adjective can also let the Book appear as a mainstay that keeps a community's order standing.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier admits the qiyam branch of a fundamental support that preserves a thing's existence and order. Supplied uses of qiyam for wealth and public institution make that sustaining function independently visible before it returns to the Book.
findings.reader_payoff: Uprightness gains a structural dimension: the Book is perceived not only as straight but as a support on which an ordered response can stand.
findings.containment: The ordinary Book reference and upright quality remain intact. The mainstay image is an analogical contextual resonance; قَيِّمًا is not translated as wealth, livelihood, or a political institution.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus branch and wider qiyam connection records are supplied, but those connections carry no explicit trust labels and the sustaining-mainstay synthesis is inferential.

branch_activations.boundary: The focus does not name material livelihood or civic institutions; those are independent triggers that bound the analogy.
